risks.title: Critical dependence on third-party distributors
risks.score_rationale: Major risk located at the beginning of the Risk Factors section (high position). Strong language: "significant challenges and risks", "limited sales to date", "terminating distributor". Stable but structural trend. High weight: distributors are the primary sales channel for Diabetes Solution and GluCurve.

risks.title: Slow adoption by healthcare professionals
risks.score_rationale: Explicit business risk with documented long sales cycles. Moderate but repeated language: "slow to adopt", "long sales cycles", "significant amount of time". Stable trend. High weight category: adoption is critical for commercial growth.

risks.title: Risk of unfavorable clinical results or superior competition
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific medical risk, positioned in Risk Factors. Direct language: "inconsistent with our clinical results", "competitors products present more favorable results". Stable trend. High weight: clinical data are fundamental to product credibility.

risks.title: Intense competition from better-resourced rivals
risks.score_rationale: Explicit and detailed competitive risk. Strong language: "substantially greater resources", "highly fragmented and very competitive", "rapid technological changes". Stable trend. High weight: direct competition threatens commercial viability.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party reimbursement for human products
risks.score_rationale: Major regulatory/commercial risk for the human segment. Explicit language: "could be less inclined to purchase", "deny coverage and reimbursement", "cannot predict". Stable trend. High weight: reimbursement determines physician adoption.

risks.title: Manufacturing risks and dependence on CGM/BGM suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain-specific operational risk. Detailed language: "difficulties in securing supply", "production capacity and yields", "quality control". Stable trend. High weight: CGM/BGM are critical components of products.

risks.title: Risk of inadequate practitioner training and improper use
risks.score_rationale: Operational risk related to human resources. Moderate language: "challenging", "cannot provide assurance", "misuse or ineffectively use". Stable trend. Medium weight: training is critical but manageable internally.

risks.title: Inability to differentiate from competing solutions
risks.score_rationale: Product positioning risk. Moderate language: "relatively new entry", "inability to distinguish", "material adverse effect". Stable trend. Medium weight: differentiation is important but ALR has potential advantages not yet realized.

ai_positioning.summary: ALR Technologies positions itself as a leader in applying AI to diabetes management, with patented technology (Predictive A1C) integrated into all its solutions. AI is central to its offering, enabling proactive insulin dose adjustments and active management by healthcare professionals.
evidence: Platform based on Predictive A1C, patented AI-assisted technology
AI used for insulin dose adjustment, FDA-approved
Solution designed to overcome clinical inertia through AI-assisted active management
